meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML. Use this whenever the user wants WeChat article formatting, article preview, WeChat draft upload, image generation for articles, cover or infographic generation, image-post creation, writer-style drafting, title suggestions, AI trace removal, or current discovery of supported providers, themes, prompts, and layout modules.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Markdown 转成可直接发布的公众号图文
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常写公众号文章,想跳过手动排版和上传。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Markdown into a WeChat article ready to publish.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write WeChat articles and want to skip manual formatting and uploading.

howto.what: 把 Markdown 文章变成微信公众号排版用的 HTML 文件,并输出一个可预览的 HTML;还能生成封面/信息图或图文帖、建议标题、去除 AI 痕迹,在你明确授权时才创建公众号草稿。
howto.when: 当用户要转 Markdown 为公众号文章(排版/预览/草稿),需要封面/标题等辅助,或查询当前支持什么时,技能触发;草稿等发布动作需明确要求。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 转成公众号格式,并预览一下。
say.note: 先检查再生成预览 HTML,不会自动上传草稿。

say.text: 给这篇文章提几个公众号标题候选。
say.note: 返回候选标题,由你决定最终用哪个。

say.text: 给这篇文章生成一张封面图。
say.note: 若未配置图像服务商,会先生成图像方案供确认。

howto.what_en: Turns a Markdown article into WeChat-OA-formatted HTML plus a preview HTML; it can also generate covers/infographics or image-text posts, suggest titles, humanize AI-sounding text, and create drafts only when you ask.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to format, preview, or draft-upload a Markdown article as a WeChat post, needs cover/title helpers, or asks what is currently supported; publish side effects require explicit requests.

say_en.text: Turn this Markdown into WeChat article format and show a preview.
say_en.note: Runs checks, writes preview HTML, and does not auto-upload.

say_en.text: Suggest a few WeChat title candidates for this article.
say_en.note: Returns candidate titles; you choose the final one.

say_en.text: Generate a cover image for this article.
say_en.note: Without an image provider configured, it returns an image plan first.
